summary: Banco Macro S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing its acquisition of 503,318 own Class B common shares at an average price of Ps$9,956.2011 per share, for an aggregate Ps$5,011,135,210, under Section 64 of Argentine Law 26,831 and CNV rules. The filing was a relevant-event notice to the CNV and BYMA/A3 Mercados dated October 30, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The buyback reduces share count and creates overhang-management considerations; watch for further repurchase disclosures and any impact on float and control.
